conventions.pixel: u = (lon - lon_left_edge) * 45, v = (lat_top_edge - lat) * 45; pixel col spans [col, col + 1)
conventions.tile: floor convention: x = (u - wr) * scale; a place's tile is the tile holding its ref_pixel centre, evaluated by the game at that tile's integer corner (earthgeo.py)
conventions.tiles_by_scale: precomputed [x, y] of that tile for scales 1 to 6 (floor convention)
conventions.expect: null = unknown; expect_when lists overrides that apply under a settings context
conventions.snap: ref_pixel is the nearest pixel of the expected kind within 8.0 px of the published point (land for cities and isthmuses, water for straits); null when none
conventions.origin: s8 rows come from the fixture; r7b, r7a, r1 and brief rows are added by toolchain; ref_pixel of an added row is the pixel holding its point (brief rows: the nearest land pixel)
